The '''Nezni system''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] located in the [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil Sector]]. An incident between the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group, [[Hurrim]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] occurred here, after the Hurrim started attacking the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] citizens that the combined forces were scavenging.

The [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-Wings]] from [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] sent by the [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']] eventually destroyed all the [[Preybird-class starfighter|Preybird fighters]] of the Hurrim and regained control of the situation.

It housed [[Golan Space Colony 1]] ''[[Corvalis]]'' and [[XQ4 Platform]] ''[[Henlon Station]]''.
